points.description: Gives the final answer f(50) = 3, reached through valid steps only, e.g. f(50)=f(25)=f(24)+1, f(24)=f(12)=f(6)=f(3)=f(2)+1, f(2)=f(1)=1, so f(3)=2, f(25)=3. Equivalent correct methods (e.g. f(n) = number of 1s in the binary expansion of n, 50 = 110010 in binary) also earn the mark. Any invalid step or a wrong final answer earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark (1) only for a correct final answer of 3 with every step valid. Any wrong step or wrong answer gets 0. No partial marks.
